name: Thrall
source:
I am Estralla Johnson, the greatest paranormal investigator in Crescent City. Until my lovers plotted my untimely demise. Now we're stuck in a tomb-like maze underground. I have to escape, but I also need answers to why I'm dead. So I rely on them, Zane Pagan and Lazarus Lockehart, walking a tightrope between reignited love and bloodshed.

Thrall is a dark urban fantasy otome visual novel with point-and-click elements about a self-righteous ghost confronting the demonic lovers of her past.

[From [url=https://authorzknight.itch.io/thrall-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我是埃斯特拉·约翰逊，新月城最伟大的超自然现象调查员。直到我的爱人策划了我的英年早逝。现在我们被困在地下坟墓般的迷宫里。我必须逃跑，但我也需要知道我为什么死的答案。所以我依靠他们，赞恩·帕根和拉扎勒斯·洛克哈特，在重新点燃的爱情和流血之间走钢丝。

《萨尔》是一部黑暗都市奇幻乙女视觉小说，带有点击元素，讲述了一个自以为是的幽灵面对她过去的恶魔恋人的故事。

[来自[url=https://authorzknight.itch.io/thrall-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
